text: {"lessons":["Judge trades by the business and evidence, not by whether a position is below my cost; selling Stock E at a 20% loss and Stock C near breakeven did not by itself make either decision sound.","Avoid reactive switching and oversized moves: buying Stock B and then selling all 250 shares after a fall to 88.66 locked in a substantial loss without a clear, tested reason.","Use a consistent plan for position sizes and risk, and review results over many periods against the market; five periods and small account-value changes are not enough to establish that my approach is working."]}
